data.title: production middleware stack mounted in reverse order (auth outside size limit)
data.detail: main.rs applied correlation->audit->size_limit->auth; axum Router::layer makes the LAST-applied layer outermost, so actual order was auth->size_limit->audit->correlation. With API keys enabled: oversized bodies silently truncated by auth's 1 MiB to_bytes cap -> 400/200 instead of 413; 401/429 bypass correlation (no X-Request-ID). Empirically reproduced (probe: 2 MiB body -> 200 with main.rs order).
